fields.v:
Agent = Claude Code 2.1.200 for all. Criterion: mean RPR over the 18 task instances (rubric-derived static, unit, integration, E2E checks + LLM-assisted criteria); Basic / Advanced averages from Table 2, overall = their mean (computed for this draft for without-skill; with-skill overall given in the text, p. 10). Cost: output tokens (K) per unit RPR, Basic / Advanced averages (Table 3); no time or money reported, and the authors say the metric is not a cost estimate (p. 12). The authors state no success criterion for quality or cost.
- Without skill + Claude Code + Claude Opus 4.8: Basic 84.0, Advanced 85.2 (overall ~84.6); tokens/RPR 64.6 / 77.3. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + Claude Opus 4.8: 92.6 / 90.2 (91.37); 60.3 / 74.1. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Without skill + Claude Code + GLM-5.2: 76.7 / 80.4 (~78.6); 45.5 / 62.5. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + GLM-5.2: 87.0 / 87.2 (87.12); 42.8 / 54.5. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Without skill + Claude Code + Kimi K2.7 Code: 66.5 / 66.8 (~66.7); 50.3 / 67.7. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + Kimi K2.7 Code: 80.3 / 84.0 (82.18); 39.8 / 46.6. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Without skill + Claude Code + DeepSeek-V4-Pro: 55.5 / 71.3 (~63.4); 49.9 / 41.0. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + DeepSeek-V4-Pro: 71.1 / 79.3 (75.23); 35.6 / 28.8. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Without skill + Claude Code + MiniMax M3: 61.5 / 59.7 (~60.6); 65.5 / 82.0. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + MiniMax M3: 70.2 / 67.0 (68.58); 52.7 / 65.0. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- Without skill + Claude Code + Qwen3.7-Max: 60.4 / 68.9 (~64.7); 55.2 / 53.8. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- With skill + Claude Code + Qwen3.7-Max: 70.9 / 80.7 (75.78); 42.1 / 43.3. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: With skill improves mean RPR by +10.31 points on average; positive in 101 of 108 model-product-scenario cells (4 lower, 3 unchanged); Basic +11.27 vs Advanced +9.35; per model +6.81 (Claude Opus 4.8) to +15.51 (Kimi K2.7 Code). Larger gains when baseline < 40% (+17.64) than 80-100% (+4.52). Output tokens per unit RPR lower with skill in all 12 model-scenario aggregates (ratio 0.69-0.96, mean 0.81), but > 1 in some product cells. Model ranking with skill: Claude Opus 4.8 91.37% > GLM-5.2 87.12 > Kimi 82.18 > Qwen 75.78 > DeepSeek 75.23 > MiniMax 68.58. No significance tests

fields.v: Distinguished conditions and models; method-level diagnostics separate structural completion (static 92.79% Basic) from executable behavior (integration 73.16%, E2E 78.24%) and domain requirements (Advanced E2E 97.03% vs LLM 61.05%). Repeatability: fresh containers; number of trials and variance not reported. Limitations stated: results grounded in Alipay products, these tasks and agent configurations; LLM rubric verification noted as noisy in related work; method scores cover different rubric subsets
